claims.head: The schedule did the Jets no favors
claims.body: It’s the Jets’ second game in two nights. Teams on the back end of those usually spend more time defending, so we think the Penguins get more of the play than usual.

claims.head: Patience vs. Spray-and-pray
claims.body: The Penguins wait for good looks, but the Jets settle for hopeful ones. Pittsburgh is near the top of the league for shot quality, and Winnipeg is one of the worst. The more dangerous chances should be the Penguins’.

PIT.head: The Penguins should be in control
PIT.body: Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Winnipeg is on the second night of a back-to-back. If the Jets want to spoil it, start with a penalty kill that holds up.

WPG.head: The Penguins should be favored
WPG.body: Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage, while Winnipeg is on the second night of a back-to-back. To pull this off, the Jets can start with a penalty kill that holds up, plus a goalie who steals the show.
